name: buddie
description: Checks what an AI agent reports against primary evidence (quotes against their sources; repo, PR and CI claims against git and GitHub; test claims against the session log), with no model in the check, plus permission-scoped environment diagnostics. A false claim goes back to the agent with the reason.

interface.shortDescription: Check an agent's report against the sources it cites, the repo and GitHub before you rely on it.
interface.longDescription: buddie checks what an agent reports: a quotation with a link against a SHA-256 snapshot of that page, a repo anchor (path#sha256, path@commit) against your checkout, pr: and ci: anchors against the GitHub API. No model takes part in the check. In Codex the plugin brings the MCP tools verify_report, snap and source_text (summary is listed too, with data only under Claude Code; environment_snapshot describes the machine categories you granted), the skills that teach anchors, and a Stop hook that returns failed verification for correction. A Stop return asks for corrected lines rather than another copy of the full answer; it does not retract an answer already displayed.
defaultPrompt: Verify this report with buddie before we use it.
